text: Infinite Canvas 是面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 客户端的节点式媒体创作工作室，可在无限画布中组织项目、剧本、分镜表、参考图、图片与视频节点，并将节点连成创作流程。它在 Harness 注册画布面板、对话工具和宿主 API，并提供聊天驱动与手动编辑两种工作方式。主要功能包括编写剧本和多镜头分镜、管理设定集与跨集记忆、生成图片视频及语音、绑定参考素材、编辑节点提示词并预览或导出成片。适合制作短剧、分镜和连续媒体项目。基础画布使用 Harness 已配置的文本模型；图片、视频或语音生成需要用户配置相应模型供应商，演示模式可离线体验。

Infinite Canvas is a node based studio for DeepSeek Harness web. It connects scripts, storyboards, images, and videos on an infinite canvas. Chat tools support drafting, memory, and generation; users can edit nodes directly. It suits short drama production. Text uses Harness models; media generation

Infinite Canvas 的功能「节点式创作画布」：在 Web 画布上创建项目，并用文本、剧本、分镜、图片、视频和成片节点组织内容。节点可连接形成创作链，用户可在聊天工具或面板中管理。
Infinite Canvas 的功能「脚本与分镜生成」：通过 Harness 的 LLM 服务生成剧本或分镜文本，再把分镜表与上游剧本及素材节点连接，按节点触发生成。
Infinite Canvas 的功能「参考资产和设定集」：项目设定集保存世界观及角色、场景和道具信息，参考素材可绑定到生成节点，辅助跨镜保持设定一致。
Infinite Canvas 的功能「分集项目记忆」：聊天工具可读取项目索引或指定画布的完整记忆，也可将每集摘要和正文写回，供后续创作延续剧情状态。
Infinite Canvas 的功能「多模态生成」：用户配置图像、视频或语音模型后，可在图片、视频等节点触发生成；支持编辑提示词并重新生成。
Infinite Canvas 的功能「导演技能包」：按剧本、分镜、提示词或资产创作类型选择透镜、题材、规格和影调切片，将选定创作指导注入文本生成。
Infinite Canvas 的功能「右侧栏并排工作」：可在 Harness 右侧栏打开画布标签，与聊天并排查看；不支持该服务时回退到主面板。
Infinite Canvas 的功能「便携项目数据」：设置数据根目录后，项目文档、资产索引和媒体文件按项目归档，并支持在不同设备之间迁移目录。
Infinite Canvas 的图片、视频与语音生成会调用用户配置的供应商端点；文本生成使用 Harness 已配置的模型服务。选择并配置生成模型前，检查供应商所需的凭据和计费方式。
Infinite Canvas 的项目内容默认保存在浏览器本地存储；配置数据根目录后，项目资料和媒体会写入该目录。外接 ArtCraft 能力需要另行安装可选的 dsh-artcraft。

@ninkch/dsh-infinite-canvas README · What is this?：Infinite Canvas is a [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) plugin that turns the web GUI's sidebar into a full creation studio. Instead of chat round-trips, you work the way directors do: nodes on an infinite canvas, wired into a pipeline — script, storyboard, character & scene assets, image generation, video generation, and a final cut with transitions, subtitles and dubbing.

@ninkch/dsh-infinite-canvas README · What is this?：Everything runs locally in your Harness. Bring your own generation APIs, or use the built-in demo mode to learn the whole flow with zero configuration.

@ninkch/dsh-infinite-canvas README · Drive it from the chat：The canvas and the agent share one brain. Every node is an AI workbench, and the **chat side is the director**: ask in plain language and the agent operates the canvas tools for you — batch work especially.

@ninkch/dsh-infinite-canvas README · Drive it from the chat：> *"Create a project called Time-Postman, write the world view and series bible first."*
> *"Write episode 1 based on the bible."* → the script node generates one episode (60–120s), every scene marked with a `【场N】` header.
> *"Expand episode 1 into scenes."* → per-scene text nodes + storyboard nodes appear, wired automatically.
> *"Generate reference images for every character, scene and prop."* → ten image nodes created and generated in one go.
> *"Generate scene 1's video."* → storyboard shots + reference images compose one multi-shot video call.
> *"Send episode 1 to FilmCraft for an MP4 render."* → FCP7 XML + SRT land in your data root for the Craft suite.

@ninkch/dsh-infinite-canvas README · Drive it from the chat：The heavy lifting — bibles, episode scripts, storyboard breakdowns, batches of reference images — is exactly what the agent is fast at. You then fine-tune the 20% you care about directly on the nodes: tweak a prompt, reorder references, re-roll one shot, pull an older result from history.

@ninkch/dsh-infinite-canvas README · Case study: 门缝里的字条：A full episode produced end to end with the flow above. The canvas with the whole episode laid out — the icon rail on the left adds nodes, the **Projects** panel on the right manages the canvases of the current project (第1集 / 第2集), while assets and the bible stay shared across the project:

text: @ninkch/dsh-infinite-canvas README · Production stage machine & auto creation (experimental)：Every canvas (one episode) carries a host-enforced **production stage** — `brief → bible → assets → script → storyboard → shots_ready → generating → qc → post → delivered` — with six code gates (bible-first, storyboard quality, one video per storyboard, no per-shot nodes, destructive-op confirmation, stage order). Gates refuse with the exact missing items and always accept an explicit-user override (audited). `canvas_production_status` is the only basis for claiming "done".

@ninkch/dsh-infinite-canvas README · Production stage machine & auto creation (experimental)：With the **Auto creation (experimental)** switch on (Settings → 自动创作), the agent runs a writers room from one sentence — research → two independent pitches → cross-critique → producer decision → bible → script → per-scene storyboards (quality-gated) → **budget sheet** — with zero paid calls; approve once and it generates videos per storyboard and builds a final-cut node. The transcript lands on the canvas as a 编剧室会议 node; questions are forbidden in this mode.

@ninkch/dsh-infinite-canvas README · Image models via `dsh-image-gen`：If the `dsh-image-gen` plugin is installed and configured, Settings shows 「图片模型（来自 dsh-image-gen）」: pick one of its providers/models and generate directly through its studio bridge — no base URL or API key in the canvas; credentials stay on the image-gen side.

@ninkch/dsh-infinite-canvas README · Precise layout：`canvas_layout_get` reads the whole board's geometry; `canvas_layout_node` batch-places nodes by coordinate (media nodes can resize, ratio-preserving) and can pin nodes so `canvas_relayout` never moves them. Relayout packs clusters in bands instead of one endless column and never covers pinned nodes.

@ninkch/dsh-infinite-canvas README · Work beside the chat：The canvas is not a separate window you have to switch to. It opens as a **tab in the Harness right pane**, so you can talk to the agent on the left and storyboard on the right **at the same time** — ask for a change in chat and watch the nodes update in place.

@ninkch/dsh-infinite-canvas README · Work beside the chat：> One live canvas at a time (shared node graph and generation state): opening it in the pane while the full-page panel is also open **moves** the canvas rather than duplicating it — the other side shows a "move the canvas here" button.
@ninkch/dsh-infinite-canvas README · Session ↔ canvas binding + project memory (multi-episode series)：Built for long-running series: **one workspace = one project, one session = one episode.**
section: Session ↔ canvas binding + project memory (multi-episode series)

text:
@ninkch/dsh-infinite-canvas README · Session ↔ canvas binding + project memory (multi-episode series)：- **Bind in the composer — only if you want to.** The canvas selector in the chat input row (same dropdown shape as 「选择工作区」) shows 选择画布 while unbound. Unbound menu = **仅会话 / 创建项目 / existing projects**: a project expands to its sub-canvases and clicking one binds the session (new sub-canvases can be created inline); touching nothing keeps the session unbound — coding and other non-canvas tasks stay untouched, and an unbind is never reversed by anything. Once bound, the project is locked: the menu shows only that project's sub-canvases (current highlighted, occupied marked 占用中) plus 新建子画布 / 打开画布 / 仅会话 (= unbind).
- **The chat agent operates exactly the bound canvas.** With the bundled「媒体创作」preset, the agent self-identifies via `canvas_my_canvas` ("this session = episode N of project X") and every `canvas_*` tool defaults to the bound canvas — write/connect/run/delete any node, update the bible, manage the episode. **Cross-canvas and cross-project operations are a code-level ban**: explicitly passing another project's or canvas's ids (including other canvases of the same project) is r

text: @ninkch/dsh-infinite-canvas README · 3D Director Stage (previz)：A blocking & previz workspace that lives inside the same project: place real glTF characters and set dressing, frame them with real cameras, and send the result back to the canvas as an image or video node.

@ninkch/dsh-infinite-canvas README · 3D Director Stage (previz)：- **Built-in "Media Studio" preset mode** — director-first guided creation (pick lens → genre/spec/look → one-sentence story → storyboard → generation → ArtCraft finishing), selectable from the mode picker; the bundled **director-workshop** skill walks a newcomer one question at a time.
- **Three modes** — **Static previz** (studio look, paused), **Dynamic previz** (studio look + timeline playback), **Live render** (final look: daylight, shadows, materials, no guides).
- **Asset library** — characters, trees, furniture, buildings, primitives, and ancient-street set pieces (pitched roofs, stalls, stone steps) in one searchable rail.
- **Direct manipulation** — local-axis move/rotate/scale gizmo, box select, **Alt-drag a scale handle = uniform scale**, **W/A/S/D + Q/E fly navigation** (hold Shift for 4x speed).
- **Shots & timeline** — shot rail with per-shot start/end, camera keyframes, ease curves, markers and loop playback.
- **Camera & optics** — FOV, focal length, sensor size and roll stay consistent; shot-size presets show the live framing percentage.
- **Export** — PNG still or MP4/WebM clip, dropped straight back

@ninkch/dsh-infinite-canvas README · 3D Director Stage (previz)：Assets are shared with the canvas: the characters, trees, furniture and buildings you already generated are directly usable as previz set dressing.

Full walkthrough — asset tabs, gizmo, keyboard map, shots and export: **[User guide → 3D Director Stage](./docs/guide.en.md#8-3d-director-stage)**.

@ninkch/dsh-infinite-canvas README · Craft page: director / genre / spec / look：The third tab of the right sidebar decides **how the whole piece is shot**. It is not a prompt template — it is a binding constraint that gets composed into every script, storyboard, image and video generation. **There are no dropdowns on the page**: every option is an icon tile; click to select, click again to clear.
section: Craft page: director / genre / spec / look

text:
@ninkch/dsh-infinite-canvas README · What each layer owns：| Layer | Count | Decides | Why it needs its own layer |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Director** | 45 | Camera language, lighting, cutting rhythm, style parameters | It constrains the shot's camera fields, the keyframe, and the video's camera move at once — the least replaceable decision in the whole piece |
| **Genre** | 36 narrative / 10 sector | Pressure mechanics, audience payoff, scene granules, episode hooks | The same "revenge" premise is fragmented neon under Wong Kar-wai and hard-lit slow motion under Tsui Hark; folding them together poisons both |
| **Spec** | 8 | Structure blocks, ASL floor, rhythm, quality bar | It decides "short drama vs cinematic texture vs commercial", which is orthogonal to genre |
| **Look** | 9 | Imaging base, material, render texture | 2D thick paint / guoman 3D / game CG are imaging domains, not directors; mixing them into the director layer makes "how to cut" fight "what it looks like" |

@ninkch/dsh-infinite-canvas README · What each layer owns：**Directors (45)**: Chinese 16 (Wong Kar-wai, Zhang Yimou, Hou Hsiao-hsien, Bi Gan, Tsui Hark, Lu Yang, Yuen Woo-ping, Wu Ershan, Ang Lee, Edward Yang, Jia Zhangke, Jiang Wen, Johnnie To, Ning Hao, Stephen Chow, Wong Jing) · Japan/Korea 7 (Kurosawa, Park Chan-wook, Bong Joon-ho, Kore-eda Hirokazu, Lee Chang-dong, Miyazaki Hayao, Shinkai Makoto) · Western 22 (Spielberg, Hitchcock, Kubrick, Scorsese, Fellini, Bergman, Tarkovsky, Nolan, Villeneuve, Fincher, Refn, Malick, Michael Mann, Coen Brothers, Ridley Scott, David Lynch, Alfonso Cuarón, Iñárritu, Wes Anderson, George Miller, Almodóvar, Guy Ritchie).
@ninkch/dsh-infinite-canvas README · What each layer owns：**Specs (8)**: Short drama · Cinematic texture · Commercial · Documentary · Music video · Trailer · Explainer · Interview.

@ninkch/dsh-infinite-canvas README · Aspect ratio is not decided here：Vertical, horizontal, square or widescreen all work with any spec — **aspect and resolution are chosen on the video node at generation time**. Vertical delivery is common for short drama, but that is a distribution choice, not a craft spec; **a short drama can equally be shot horizontal and to a cinematic standard**.
section: Aspect ratio is not decided here

text:
@ninkch/dsh-infinite-canvas README · Where it is injected：| Node / capability | What it receives |
|---|---|
| Script node | Genre cards + the lens's narrative/rhythm/performance sections + the form's structure blocks |
| Storyboard node | The lens's camera language, lighting, style parameters and shot checklist + the form + the camera-move dictionary |
| Image node | A style lock: style parameters + look imaging/material + genre granules + three negative lists |
| Video node | Same (also appended when an upstream storyboard feeds it, without breaking the structured format) |
| Character/scene/prop sheets | The lens's lighting and colour + the look card |
| Bible AI draft | Same as script |
@ninkch/dsh-infinite-canvas README · Where it is injected：**With all four layers empty nothing is injected** — existing projects behave exactly as before.

@ninkch/dsh-infinite-canvas README · It works from the chat too：The configuration is stored on the project document (same sync mechanism as the series bible), so **the chat side reads the same selection the panel shows**. Say "shoot this in Wong Kar-wai's style" in chat and the agent calls `canvas_list_skills` to see what craft exists, then `canvas_skill_pack` to pull the matching slice — **the same slice the canvas itself uses**.

Full walkthrough — **[User guide → Craft page](./docs/guide.en.md#9-craft-page-four-layer-console)**.
section: It works from the chat too

text:
@ninkch/dsh-infinite-canvas README · How it works：```mermaid flowchart LR A[Script node
ONE episode · scene headers] --> B[Expand to scenes
text + storyboard per scene] B --> C[Multi-shot video per scene
shots + refs in ONE call] C --> D[Tail-frame chaining
scene N last frame → N+1 first frame]

@ninkch/dsh-infinite-canvas README · Consistent characters, scene after scene：A per-project **series bible** (style baseline + character/scene/prop cards) is injected into every AI call, so wardrobes, locations and props stay coherent across shots and episodes. Entities referenced with `@name` in a prompt automatically carry their bible description and reference assets. After each storyboard run, a consistency check flags any name that isn't registered yet, and the agent fills the gaps.

@ninkch/dsh-infinite-canvas README · References that actually bind：Reference images connect as an ordered, visible list — `[图1] 角色：Lin Ning`, `[图2] 场景：The Old House` — and that exact order is what reaches the model. Multi-character frames stay unambiguous, and Volcano Engine **Seedance**'s native `[图N]` convention is supported end to end (first frame, up to 4 reference images, official task API).

@ninkch/dsh-infinite-canvas README · From shots to a watchable cut：**One storyboard = one multi-shot video generation.** Expanding a storyboard wires it to a single video node: every shot (order + per-shot duration) is composed into one multi-shot prompt and your video model renders the whole clip in one call — the model makes the hard cuts, no per-shot stitching seams. The **Final Cut node** then stitches segments in order — crossfade or black transitions, burned-in subtitles, original audio and TTS voices mixed in — and exports a preview cut instantly. For real post-production, one click writes a **FCP7 XML timeline + SRT** to disk and hands the render to [ArtCraft](#artcraft-bridge) (FilmCraft) for a true MP4.
section: From shots to a watchable cut

text: @ninkch/dsh-infinite-canvas README · An editor-grade canvas：Pan, zoom, marquee select, alignment guides, groups that fold, a minimap, 60-step undo/redo, per-node media history (last 8 results), mask-based inpainting, and middle-click everything — the canvas part should feel like an editor, not a chat sidebar.

@ninkch/dsh-infinite-canvas README · Bring your own models：Text models come from Harness itself (no extra keys, no per-plugin parameters). Image and video backends use a **provider + model** structure: configure a provider once (URL, key, optional vendor-specific **extra params** as JSON) and list as many model IDs under it as you like; star one as the **default route** for nodes that don't pick one. Video endpoints are auto-adapted — OpenAI-style task APIs, Seedance-native `content[]` gateways and Sora-style `/v1/videos` are covered by an automatic fallback chain, resolutions/ratios/first-frames/references are mapped to each vendor's conventions, and oversized references are downscaled before sending. Every gateway call is relayed through the local Harness host process, so **any vendor works** (no CORS headaches). No backend configured? Demo mode synthesizes placeholder images and animated videos locally so the entire pipeline is testable offline.

@ninkch/dsh-infinite-canvas README · A portable data root：Set a **data root folder** once and everything lands there, organized by **project name**: nodes and the series bible in `project.json`, the asset index in `assets.json`, media under `image/ video/ audio/ text/`, and Craft post-production under `craft/`. **Moving to a new machine = copying the folder**: point the new install's data root at it and every project (assets, bible, media) is recognized — plus a one-click **Import from data root** for anything not yet on disk. Put the folder inside a cloud-sync directory and multiple machines stay in sync automatically.

@ninkch/dsh-infinite-canvas README · Quick start：1. Install the plugin (bundle folder) and restart Harness once.
2. Click the **Infinite Canvas** button in the left sidebar, and set a **data root** in Settings.
3. In the chat: *"Create a project called <your idea>, write the world view and series bible first."*
4. *"Write episode 1."* → script node generates one episode with `【场N】` scene headers → click **Expand to scenes** (or ask the agent) to get text + storyboard nodes per scene.
5. *"Generate reference images for all characters, scenes and props."* → named, bible-consistent asset images in one batch.
6. *"Generate scene 1's video."* → storyboard shots + references compose one multi-shot video call; chain scenes via tail-frame → first-frame.
7. Open a **Final Cut** node for the preview cut, or export to FilmCraft for a true MP4.

@ninkch/dsh-infinite-canvas README · Quick start：> Without any generation API configured, every step runs in demo mode — the full pipeline works offline.

The full walkthrough (with screenshots, model configuration and data-root migration) lives in the [Chinese user guide](./docs/guide.zh-CN.md).

@ninkch/dsh-infinite-canvas README · Generation backends：| Kind | Protocol | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Text | Harness LLM service | Episode scripts & storyboard writers; pick any configured model, or override per node |
| Image | OpenAI-compatible `/images/generations`, multi-reference via `/images/edits` | Provider + model list with starred default; size (1K/2K/4K) × ratio; extra params as JSON; mask inpainting via `edits` + PNG mask |
| Video | OpenAI-style task APIs, Seedance-native `content[]`, Sora-style `/v1/videos` — automatic fallback chain | Episodes per scene (≤15s), 480P/720P/1080P, ratio, first frame, multi-reference (auto-downscaled), voice references via `audios[]` |
| TTS | OpenAI-compatible `/audio/speech` | Per-shot voices mixed into the final cut |

@ninkch/dsh-infinite-canvas README · Generation backends：All gateway calls are relayed by the local Harness host process (no browser CORS limits) — any vendor endpoint with an OpenAI-style shape works.

@ninkch/dsh-infinite-canvas README · ArtCraft bridge：When the companion [`dsh-artcraft`](../dsh-artcraft/README.md) plugin is installed, the canvas talks to the local **Craft family** (PhotoCraft, FilmCraft, EffectCraft, LightCraft, VectorCraft, DesignCraft, … — every bin the Craft suite reports, currently 12) over same-origin HTTP. Point ArtCraft's data root at the same folder as the canvas data root and all post-production lands in `projects/<project>/craft/` next to your other data: assets sync per project, images get headless PhotoCraft grading (single or batch), and final cuts export as FCP7 XML + SRT for FilmCraft to render as MP4. A status card in Settings shows one light per craft with an n/n ready summary.

@ninkch/dsh-infinite-canvas README · Publishing (maintainers)：The maintainer runbook (red lines, branch model, versioning) lives in [`RELEASING.md`](RELEASING.md); the operations detail in [`docs/release.md`](docs/release.md); released changes in [`CHANGELOG.md`](CHANGELOG.md) — **GitHub Release notes are written in English** and copied from the changelog.

Publishing runs through **npm Trusted Publishing** (OIDC) — no npm token exists anywhere:

@ninkch/dsh-infinite-canvas README · Publishing (maintainers)：- **Release flow**: dev tested & approved → merge to `main` → create a GitHub Release (tag `v0.17.9`, …) → Actions publishes that version automatically.
- The `publish.yml` workflow guards on the release commit being on `main` and the tag matching `package.json`, then publishes with a `provenance` badge.

@ninkch/dsh-infinite-canvas README · Data & privacy：- Canvas documents, projects and settings live in browser `localStorage` (`dsh-ic:*`); asset metadata lives in IndexedDB (`dsh-infinite-canvas`) while media files persist **on disk** once a data root is set (per-project folders by project name, served by the plugin backend with HTTP Range support for video seeking).
- AI text generation runs through the Harness host process (your configured models, no extra keys).
- Image/video/TTS gateway calls are relayed by the local Harness host process (avoids browser CORS limits); your endpoints and keys stay local.
- Nothing is uploaded anywhere by the plugin itself.

@ninkch/dsh-infinite-canvas README · Requirements & limitations：- DeepSeek Harness 0.2.0-rc.2+; demo video export needs MediaRecorder (Chromium).
- The preview cut is real-time recorded WebM; for MP4 masters with multi-track editing, pair with ArtCraft FilmCraft or any NLE.
- Image `edits`/mask inpainting requires a model that supports the endpoint (e.g. gpt-image-1).
- Host-side plugin updates need one Harness restart; the web half hot-reloads.
@ninkch/dsh-infinite-canvas README · License：Apache-2.0

@ninkch/dsh-infinite-canvas README · 这是什么？：无限画布是一个 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) 插件：它在 Web 界面侧边栏加入一个完整的创作工作室。你像导演一样工作——无限画布上的节点连成流水线：剧本、分镜、角色与场景资产、图片生成、视频生成，最终在成片节点完成转场、字幕与配音。

全部本地运行于你的 Harness。生成后端自带或自配均可；未配置任何 API 时有内置演示模式，整条流水线离线可学可测。

@ninkch/dsh-infinite-canvas README · 用对话驱动画布：画布与对话共享同一个"大脑"。每个节点都是一个 AI 工位，而**对话侧就是导演**：用自然语言下指令，Agent 替你操作画布工具——批量工作尤其如此。

> 「创建一个叫《时空邮递员》的项目，先写世界观和设定集。」
> 「根据设定集写第一集。」→ 剧本节点生成一整集（60–120 秒），每个场景带【场N】分场标记。
> 「把第一集铺开到场景。」→ 每场一个文本节点 + 分镜表节点自动出现并连线。
> 「把所有角色、场景、道具的参考图都生成了。」→ 十个图片节点一次建好、逐个生成。
> 「生成场1的视频。」→ 分镜镜头 + 参考图合成一次多镜头视频调用。
> 「把第一集交给 FilmCraft 渲染 MP4。」→ FCP7 XML + SRT 落盘，Craft 套件接手。

设定集、整集剧本、分镜拆解、成批参考图——这些批量工作正是 Agent 最快的部分。跑完后你只需要在画布上精修真正在意的那 20%：改提示词、调参考图顺序、重掷某一个镜头、从历史里回退旧结果。

@ninkch/dsh-infinite-canvas README · 案例：门缝里的字条：用上面的流程完整制作的一集。整集铺开后的画布全览——左侧一列图标添加节点，右侧「项目」面板管理当前项目的画布（第1集 / 第2集），资产与设定集在项目内共享：

场1 的镜头组——场1分镜表 → 角色/场景多视图 → 场1视频，节点之间用连线表达参考关系：

节点 + 生成面板：点击节点内容区弹出面板，参考图在顶部缩略图条里可拖拽排序，模型/比例/清晰度/张数一行排开：

设定集弹窗——世界观、风格基调、角色/场景/道具条目，每条都可以绑定参考资产：

资产弹窗——卡片网格，搜索/分类/项目筛选，视频以首帧作为缩略图：

左上角项目名点开是项目下拉：每行显示「项目名 · 画布名」，可直接就地改名，超过 5 个项目自动分页并可跳页：

设置页签——数据根目录、Craft 状态、技能增强（通用专家）、文本模型与图片/视频/TTS 供应商：

快捷键与操作：

帮助与反馈：

@ninkch/dsh-infinite-canvas README · 制作阶段机与自动创作（实验）：每个画布（一集）都有宿主强制的**制作阶段**：`brief → bible → assets → script → storyboard → shots_ready → generating → qc → post → delivered`，配合六道代码闸门（设定集先行 / 分镜质量 / 一表一视频 / 禁逐镜节点 / 破坏性确认 / 阶段越序）。闸门拒绝时会列出确切缺失项，并始终接受用户显式 override（进审计）；宣称"完成"必须以 `canvas_production_status` 的 `ready:true` 为据。

打开「**自动创作（实验）**」开关（设置页）后，对话智能体从一句话创意跑通编剧室：调研 → 编剧A/B 独立提案 → 互评 → 监制决策 → 设定集 → 剧本 → 逐场分镜表（过质量闸门）→ **预算单**——全程零付费；批准一次后逐分镜表生成视频并建成片节点。讨论记录落在画布「编剧室会议」节点；该模式下**禁止向用户提问**。
section: 制作阶段机与自动创作（实验）

text: @ninkch/dsh-infinite-canvas README · 图片模型：直接用 `dsh-image-gen`：装了 `dsh-image-gen` 并配置好模型后，设置页出现「图片模型（来自 dsh-image-gen）」：直接选它的服务商/模型生图——画布侧**无需**再填 baseURL/API Key，凭据留在 image-gen 侧。
@ninkch/dsh-infinite-canvas README · 精准布局：`canvas_layout_get` 读取全图几何；`canvas_layout_node` 按坐标批量摆放（媒体节点可改尺寸且保持画面比例），并可 `pinned` 钉住——`canvas_relayout` 永远不动钉住的节点，簇按带高打包、不再拍成一整列。

@ninkch/dsh-infinite-canvas README · 在对话旁边工作：画布不是必须切过去的另一个窗口——它可以作为 **Harness 右侧面板里的一个页签**打开，左边对话、右边分镜，**同时进行**：在对话里提要求，右边节点实时跟着变。

1. 打开右侧面板（**开始**），点击 **无限画布** 卡片。
2. 画布以页签形式出现在对话右侧，与全屏面板共享同一批项目、节点与资产。
3. 需要更大空间时，把右栏拖宽，或用右栏的全屏按钮。

> 同一时刻只有一个画布实例（共享节点图与生成状态）：在右栏打开时若全屏面板也开着，画布会**被移动到右栏**而不是复制一份——另一侧显示「把画布切换到这里」按钮。

@ninkch/dsh-infinite-canvas README · 会话↔画布绑定 + 项目记忆（多集连续创作）：- **输入行绑定——想绑才绑**：对话输入行的画布选择器（「选择工作区」同款下拉格式）默认显示「选择画布」。未绑定态菜单 = **仅会话 / 创建项目 / 已有项目列表**：点项目展开其子画布，点画布即绑定（也可就地新建子画布）；不点 = 仅会话，编码等任务零打扰，且解绑后不会被任何机制绑回。已绑定态项目锁定，只列本项目的子画布（当前项高亮、占用标「占用中」）+ 新建子画布 + 打开画布 + 仅会话（解绑）。
- **会话 Agent 只操作绑定的那张画布**：配合内置「媒体创作」预设，Agent 先用 `canvas_my_canvas` 自证身份（「本会话 = 某项目第 N 集」），之后所有 `canvas_*` 工具缺省即作用于本集画布——写节点/连线/触发/删除/改设定集全量可操作。**跨画布、跨项目是代码级禁令**：显式传其他项目/画布的 id（含同项目其他画布）会被工具直接拒绝（locked），文案指引先解绑；未绑定的会话不受任何限制。
- **项目记忆让 100 集连续不乱套**：每集画布有自己的记忆（剧情决策/人物状态变化/伏笔账本），项目级调度索引汇总全部集的标题/摘要/关键词/状态。技能纪律要求 Agent 开写前先读索引与本集记忆、每到一个里程碑必须回写——第 47 集不会重复发明第 12 集已经定下的东西。画布「记忆」页签可随时翻看任何一集的记忆全文。
- **数据跟着工作区走**：`project.json`、`canvases/`、`memory/`、`bindings.json` 全部在 `<工作区目录>/.infinite-canvas/` 里——拷走目录 = 搬走整部剧。（媒体文件仍在插件数据根目录。）
section: 会话↔画布绑定 + 项目记忆（多集连续创作）

text:
@ninkch/dsh-infinite-canvas README · 3D 导演台（预演）：- **内置「媒体创作」预设模式**：导演第一视角的引导式创作（选透镜 → 定题材/规格/影调 → 一句话故事 → 分镜 → 生成 → ArtCraft 后期），随插件安装、在模式选择器直接可选；附带的**导演工作坊**技能一次只问一个问题，带新手走完全程。
- **三种模式**：**静态预演**（影棚外观、暂停摆位）、**动态预演**（影棚外观 + 时间轴播放）、**实时渲染**（成片外观：日光、阴影、材质，无辅助线）。
- **资产库**：人物、树木、家具、建筑、几何体，以及古街陈设（坡屋顶、摊位、石阶），一个搜索栏全覆盖。
- **直接操作**：局部轴移动/旋转/缩放操作轴、框选、**Alt + 拖轴端方块 = 等比缩放**、**W/A/S/D + Q/E 键盘漫游**（按住 Shift 加速 4 倍）。
- **分镜与时间轴**：分镜轨、单镜起止、机位关键帧、缓动曲线、标记、循环播放。
- **机位与光学**：FOV、焦段、传感器尺寸、滚筒角联动一致；景别预设直接显示当前构图占比。
- **导出**：PNG 截图或 MP4/WebM 预演视频，直接落成画布上的图片/视频节点。

@ninkch/dsh-infinite-canvas README · 3D 导演台（预演）：资产与画布共享：你已经生成的角色、树木、家具、建筑，可以直接拿来当预演场景的摆件。

完整操作（资产页签、操作轴、快捷键表、分镜、导出）：**[操作手册 → 3D 导演台](./docs/guide.zh-CN.md#8-3d-导演台)**。
@ninkch/dsh-infinite-canvas README · 技能页：导演 / 题材 / 规格 / 影调：右栏第三个页签「技能」决定**整部片怎么拍**。它不是提示词模板，而是会被自动拼进每一次剧本、分镜、图片、视频生成的硬约束。**页面里没有任何下拉框**，全部是图标瓦片，点一下选中、再点一下取消。
section: 技能页：导演 / 题材 / 规格 / 影调

text:
@ninkch/dsh-infinite-canvas README · 四层各管什么：| 层 | 数量 | 决定 | 为什么单独一层 |
|---|---|---|---|
| **导演** | 45 | 镜头语言、灯光色彩、剪辑节奏、风格参数 | 它同时约束分镜的机位字段、图片关键帧、视频运镜——整部片最不可替换的决策 |
| **题材** | 叙事 36 / 行业 10 | 压力机制、观众回报、场面颗粒、集尾钩子 | 同一个「复仇打脸」，王家卫拍是抽帧暧昧，徐克拍是凌厉升格；混进导演层会互相污染 |
| **规格** | 8 | 结构块、平均镜长下限、节奏、质量档 | 它决定「这是短剧、电影质感还是商业片」，与题材正交 |
| **影调** | 9 | 成像底层、材质、渲染质感 | 2D 厚涂 / 国漫 3D / 游戏 CG 是成像域，不是导演；塞进导演会让「怎么剪」和「长什么样」打架 |

@ninkch/dsh-infinite-canvas README · 四层各管什么：**导演（45 位）**：华语 16（王家卫、张艺谋、侯孝贤、毕赣、徐克、路阳、袁和平、乌尔善、李安、杨德昌、贾樟柯、姜文、杜琪峰、宁浩、周星驰、王晶）· 日韩 7（黑泽明、朴赞郁、奉俊昊、是枝裕和、李沧东、宫崎骏、新海诚）· 欧美 22（斯皮尔伯格、希区柯克、库布里克、斯科塞斯、费里尼、伯格曼、塔可夫斯基、诺兰、维伦纽瓦、芬奇、雷弗恩、马力克、迈克尔·曼、科恩兄弟、雷德利·斯科特、大卫·林奇、阿方索·卡隆、伊纳里图、韦斯·安德森、乔治·米勒、阿莫多瓦、盖·里奇）。

**规格（8 种）**：短剧 · 电影质感 · 商业片 · 纪实 · 音乐视频 · 预告 · 解说 · 访谈。
@ninkch/dsh-infinite-canvas README · 画幅不在技能里决定：横屏、竖屏、方屏、宽银幕都能用任何规格——**画幅与分辨率是视频节点生成时的选项**。短剧竖屏投放很常见，但那是发行选择，不是创作规格；**短剧同样可以横屏、可以按电影标准拍**。

@ninkch/dsh-infinite-canvas README · 注入到哪：| 节点 / 能力 | 拿到的内容 |
|---|---|
| 剧本节点 | 题材卡 + 导演的叙事/节奏/表演节 + 规格的结构块 |
| 分镜表节点 | 导演的镜头语言/灯光/风格参数/拍摄清单 + 规格 + 运镜词典 |
| 图片节点 | 「风格增强锁」：风格参数 + 影调成像材质 + 题材颗粒 + 三份负向词 |
| 视频节点 | 同上（有上游分镜表时也追加，不打断结构化字段） |
| 角色/场景/道具设定图 | 导演的灯光色彩 + 影调卡 |
| 设定集 AI 草稿 | 同剧本 |

**四层全空时什么都不注入**——老项目行为完全不变。

@ninkch/dsh-infinite-canvas README · 对话侧同样生效：配置存在项目文档里（与设定集同一套同步机制），所以**对话侧读得到、面板上也看得到**。在对话里说「用王家卫的风格拍这段」，Agent 会调 `canvas_list_skills` 看有哪些技能、再调 `canvas_skill_pack` 取对应切片——**和画布自生成用的是同一套口径**。

完整说明见 **[操作手册 → 技能页](./docs/guide.zh-CN.md#9-技能页四层创作控制台)**。

@ninkch/dsh-infinite-canvas README · 工作方式：```mermaid flowchart LR A[剧本节点
一集 · 场景标记] --> B[铺开到场景
每场 文本+分镜表] B --> C[每场多镜头视频
镜头+参考图一次生成] C --> D[尾帧串联
场N尾帧 → 场N+1首帧]
@ninkch/dsh-infinite-canvas README · 角色一致，跨镜跨集：项目级**设定集**（风格基调 + 角色/场景/道具卡）注入每一次 AI 调用，服装、场景、道具跨镜跨集保持一致。提示词里的 `@名称` 自动携带该实体的设定描述与参考资产。每次分镜生成后一致性检查会标出未登记实体，Agent 自动补全。
@ninkch/dsh-infinite-canvas README · 参考图真正绑定：参考图以有序、可见的列表连线（`[图1] 角色：陈拾`、`[图2] 场景：褶皱巷`），这个顺序就是到达模型的顺序。多角色画面不再含糊；Volcano **Seedance** 的原生 `[图N]` 约定端到端支持（首帧、最多 4 张参考图、官方任务 API）。

@ninkch/dsh-infinite-canvas README · 从分镜到可看成片：**一个分镜表 = 一次多镜头视频生成。** 全部镜头（顺序 + 每镜时长）合成一条提示词，视频模型一次调用渲染整段——硬切由模型完成，没有逐镜拼接的接缝。每场 ≤ 15 秒，多场之间用**尾帧 → 首帧**串联。**成片节点**按顺序拼接片段——交叉溶解或黑场转场、烧录字幕、原声与 TTS 配音混音——即时导出预览版；接 [ArtCraft](#artcraft-桥接)（FilmCraft）则写出 **FCP7 XML 时间线 + SRT** 渲染真正的 MP4。
@ninkch/dsh-infinite-canvas README · 编辑器级画布：平移缩放、框选、对齐参考线、可折叠分组、小地图、60 步撤销重做、节点媒体历史（最近 8 次）、蒙版局部重绘、全要素中键——画布应该像剪辑软件，不像聊天侧栏。

@ninkch/dsh-infinite-canvas README · 模型自带或自配：文本模型直接来自 Harness（无额外 Key）。图片/视频后端采用**供应商 + 模型**两级结构：供应商配一次（地址、Key、可选的厂商专属**扩展参数 JSON**），下面挂任意多个模型 ID，点 ★ 星标作为默认路由。视频端点自动适配——OpenAI 风格任务接口、Seedance 原生 `content[]`、Sora 风格 `/v1/videos` 由自动降级链覆盖，分辨率/比例/首帧/参考图按厂商惯例映射，超大参考图发送前自动压缩。所有网关调用经本地 Harness 宿主进程转发（无浏览器 CORS 限制）。什么都没配？演示模式本地合成占位图与动画视频，整条流水线离线可测。

@ninkch/dsh-infinite-canvas README · 便携数据根目录：设置一次**数据根目录**，所有数据按**项目名**落盘：节点与设定集在 `project.json`，资产索引在 `assets.json`，媒体在 `image/ video/ audio/ text/`，Craft 后期产物在 `craft/`。**换电脑 = 复制文件夹**：新机器把数据根目录指过去，所有项目（资产、设定集、媒体）自动识别——另有**「从数据根导入」**一键合并。把目录放进网盘同步文件夹，多台机器自动保持一致。

@ninkch/dsh-infinite-canvas README · 快速开始：1. 安装插件（bundle 目录）并重启一次 Harness。
2. 点侧边栏 **Infinite Canvas**，在设置里配好**数据根目录**。
3. 对话：*「创建一个项目叫〈你的创意〉，先写世界观和设定集。」*
4. *「写第一集。」* → 剧本节点生成带【场N】标记的一集 → 点**铺开到场景**（或让 Agent 做），得到每场的文本+分镜表组合。
5. *「把所有角色、场景、道具的参考图生成了。」* → 一批命名规范、与设定集一致的资产图。
6. *「生成场1的视频。」* → 分镜镜头 + 参考图合成一次多镜头调用；场与场之间尾帧串联。
7. 打开**成片节点**导出预览版，或交给 FilmCraft 渲染正式 MP4。

> 未配置任何生成 API 时，全部步骤以演示模式运行——整条流水线离线可用。

完整的图文教程（含截图、模型配置与数据目录迁移）见[中文操作手册](./docs/guide.zh-CN.md)。

@ninkch/dsh-infinite-canvas README · 生成后端：| 类型 | 协议 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| 文本 | Harness LLM 服务 | 整集剧本与分镜拆解；可选任意已配置模型，或按节点覆盖 |
| 图片 | OpenAI 兼容 `/images/generations`，多参考走 `/images/edits` | 供应商+模型列表（星标默认）；尺寸（1K/2K/4K）× 比例；扩展参数 JSON；`edits`+PNG 蒙版局部重绘 |
| 视频 | OpenAI 风格任务接口、Seedance 原生 `content[]`、Sora 风格 `/v1/videos`——自动降级链 | 每场一集（≤15s）、480P/720P/1080P、比例、首帧、多参考图（自动压缩）、`audios[]` 声音参考 |
| TTS | OpenAI 兼容 `/audio/speech` | 每镜配音混入成片 |

所有网关调用由本地 Harness 宿主进程转发（无浏览器 CORS 限制）——任何 OpenAI 风格的厂商端点都可用。

@ninkch/dsh-infinite-canvas README · ArtCraft 桥接：安装姊妹插件 [`dsh-artcraft`](../dsh-artcraft/README.md) 后，画布可与本地 **Craft 家族**（PhotoCraft、FilmCraft、EffectCraft、LightCraft、VectorCraft、DesignCraft 等 12 个）经同源 HTTP 协作。把 ArtCraft 的数据根目录指向与画布相同的位置，全部后期产物落在 `projects/<项目>/craft/`：资产按项目同步、图片支持 PhotoCraft 无头调色（单个/批量）、成片导出 FCP7 XML + SRT 交 FilmCraft 渲染 MP4。设置面板的状态卡为每个 Craft 显示一盏状态灯与 n/n 就绪摘要。

发布走 **npm Trusted Publishing**（OIDC）——任何地方都不存在 npm 令牌：

- **发布流程**：dev 测试通过并获批准 → 合并进 `main` → 创建 GitHub Release（tag `v0.17.11`，…）→ Actions 自动发布该版本。
- `publish.yml` 工作流内置守卫：release 提交必须在 `main` 上、tag 必须与 `package.json` 一致，然后带 `provenance` 徽章发布。

@ninkch/dsh-infinite-canvas README · 数据与隐私：- 画布文档、项目与设置存于浏览器 `localStorage`（`dsh-ic:*`）；资产元数据存于 IndexedDB（`dsh-infinite-canvas`）；设置数据根目录后媒体文件**落盘**（按项目名分目录，插件后端带 HTTP Range 支持视频拖动）。
- AI 文本生成经 Harness 宿主进程（用你已配置的模型，无额外 Key）。
- 图片/视频/TTS 网关调用由本地 Harness 宿主进程转发（规避浏览器 CORS）；你的端点与 Key 都留在本地。
- 插件自身不向任何第三方上传数据。
